headline: The research-corpus ledger tracks 5 allowlisted public repositories
dek: Only Git ref advertisements and default-branch cursors are published; notice bodies, keyword lists and routing rules stay unpublished.

claims.statement: The current metadata-only ledger covers 5 allowlisted research repositories.

method.summary: one bounded keyless Git smart-HTTP ref advertisement per source; exact default-branch cursor plus aggregate ref-count deltas

limitations: A commit cursor change is not a claim about why the repository moved, and unpublished notice bodies cannot be inferred from the metadata.
